class [NodeTimeoutException](index.html)(val nodeName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val timeout: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html), cause: [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html)? = null) : [NodeExecutionException](../-node-execution-exception/index.html)
